40020859.author: पदार्थः
40020859.content: सः he, तु indeed, दत्त्वा having given, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), वनम् forest, घोरम् terrible, खरस्य to Khara, तत् that, भगिनीम् sister, च and, समाश्वास्य having consoled, हृष्टः delighted, स्वस्थतरः more at ease, अभवत् became.

40020859.author: Translation
40020859.content: Having given that terrible forest to Khara and having consoled his sister, Dashagriva became delighted and more at ease.

40020860.author: पदार्थः
40020860.content: ततः then, निकुम्भिला Nikumbhila, नाम named, लङ्का of Lanka, उपवनम् pleasure grove, उत्तमम् excellent, तत् that, राक्षसेन्द्रः king of Rakshasas (Ravana), बलवान् powerful, प्रविवेश entered, सह with, अनुगः followers.

40020860.author: Translation
40020860.content: Then, the powerful king of Rakshasas, Ravana, entered that excellent pleasure grove of Lanka named Nikumbhila, along with his followers.

40020861.author: पदार्थः
40020861.content: ततः then, यूपशताकीर्णम् filled with hundreds of sacrificial posts, सौम्यचैत्योपशोभितम् adorned with auspicious altars, ददर्श he saw, विष्ठितम् established, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, श्रिया with splendor, सम्प्रज्वलन्निव as if blazing forth.

40020861.author: Translation
40020861.content: Then, he saw the established sacrifice, which was filled with hundreds of sacrificial posts and adorned with auspicious altars, appearing as if it was blazing forth with splendor.

40020862.author: पदार्थः
40020862.content: ततः then, कृष्णाजिनधरम् wearing a black deer skin, कमण्डलुशिखाध्वजम् with a water-pot and a top-knot as his emblem, ददर्श he saw, स्वसुतम् his own son, तत्र there, मेघनादम् Meghanada, भयावहम् formidable.

40020862.author: Translation
40020862.content: Then, he saw his own formidable son, Meghanada, there, wearing a black deer skin and distinguished by his water-pot and top-knot.

40020863.author: पदार्थः
40020863.content: तम् him, समासाद्य having approached, लङ्केशः the lord of Lanka, परिष्वज्वाथ and having embraced, बाहुभिः with his arms, अब्रवीत् he said, किमिदम् what is this, वत्स my son, वर्तसे you are doing, ब्रूहि tell me, तत्त्वतः truly.

40020863.author: Translation
40020863.content: Having approached and embraced him with his arms, Ravana, the lord of Lanka, asked, "My son, what is this you are doing? Tell me the truth."

40020864.author: पदार्थः
40020864.content: उशना Ushana, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् he said, तत्र there, यज्ञसम्पत्समृद्धये for the prosperity of the sacrificial wealth, रावणम् to Ravana, राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् the best of Rakshasas, द्विजश्रेष्ठः the best of Brahmins, महातपाः of great penance.

40020864.author: Translation
40020864.content: There, Ushana, the best of Brahmins and of great penance, spoke to Ravana, the best of Rakshasas, regarding the successful completion of the sacrifice.

40020865.author: पदार्थः
40020865.content: अहम् I, आख्यामि will tell, ते to you, राजन् O King, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, सर्वम् all, एव indeed, तत् that, यज्ञाः sacrifices, ते your, सप्त seven, पुत्रेण by your son, प्राप्ताः attained, सुबहुविस्तराः very extensive.

40020865.author: Translation
40020865.content: Ushana then said, "O King, I will tell you all about it; listen, for your son has completed seven very extensive sacrifices."

40020866.author: पदार्थः
40020866.content: अग्निष्टोमः Agnishtoma, अश्वमेधः Ashwamedha, च and, यज्ञः sacrifice, बहुसुवर्णकः Bahusuvarnaka, राजसूयः Rajasuya, तथा and also, यज्ञः sacrifice, गोमेधः Gomedha, वैष्ववः Vaishvava, तथा and also.

40020866.author: Translation
40020866.content: The Agnishtoma, Ashwamedha, Bahusuvarnaka, Rajasuya, Gomedha, and Vaishvava are all types of sacrifices.

40020867.author: पदार्थः
40020867.content: माहेश्वरे in the Maheswara, प्रवृत्ते when commenced, तु indeed, यज्ञे sacrifice, पुम्भिः by men, सुदुर्लभे very difficult to perform, वरान् boons, ते your, लब्धवान् obtained, पुत्रः son, साक्षात् directly, पशुपतेः from Pashupati, इह here.

40020867.author: Translation
40020867.content: When the Maheswara sacrifice, which is very difficult for men to perform, was commenced, your son directly obtained boons from Pashupati (Lord Shiva) here.

40020868.author: पदार्थः
40020868.content: कामगम् moving at will, स्यन्दनम् a chariot, दिव्यम् divine, अन्तरिक्षचरम् moving in the sky, ध्रुवम् firm, मायाम् illusion, च and, तामसीम् Tamasi, नाम named, यया by which, सम्पद्यते is produced, तमः darkness.

40020868.author: Translation
40020868.content: He obtained a divine chariot that moves at will, travels in the sky, and is firm, and also an illusion named Tamasi, by which darkness is produced.

40020869.author: पदार्थः
40020869.content: एतया by this, किल indeed, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, मायया by illusion, राक्षसेश्वर O Lord of Rakshasas, प्रयुक्तया when employed, गतिः movement, शक्या possible, न not, हि indeed, ज्ञातुम् to know, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras.

40020869.author: Translation
40020869.content: O Lord of Rakshasas, it is said that when this illusion is employed in battle, its movement cannot indeed be ascertained by even gods and asuras.

40020870.author: पदार्थः
40020870.content: अक्षयाविषुधी two inexhaustible quivers, बाणैः with arrows, चापम् a bow, च and, अपि also, सुदुर्जयम् very difficult to conquer, अस्त्रम् a weapon, च and, बलवत् powerful, राजन् O King, शत्रुविध्वंसनम् destroyer of enemies, रणे in battle.

40020870.author: Translation
40020870.content: O King, he also obtained two inexhaustible quivers with arrows, a bow that is very difficult to conquer, and a powerful weapon that destroys enemies in battle.

40020871.author: पदार्थः
40020871.content: दशानन O Dashanana, एतान् सर्वान् all these, वरान् boons, लब्ध्वा having obtained, ते अयं पुत्रः this son of yours, अद्य today, यज्ञसमाप्तौ at the conclusion of the sacrifice, त्वां you, दिदृक्षुः desiring to see, स्थितः हि अहम् I indeed stand here.

40020871.author: Translation
40020871.content: Having obtained all these boons, O Dashanana, your son, now that the sacrifice is concluded, and I myself, stand here eager to behold you.

40020872.author: पदार्थः
40020872.content: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, न not, शोभनम् good, इदम् this, कृतम् done, पूजिताः worshipped, शत्रवः enemies, यस्मात् because, द्रव्यैः with wealth, इन्द्रपुरोगमाः Indra and others.

40020872.author: Translation
40020872.content: Then Dashagriva spoke, saying that this was not good because the enemies, led by Indra, had been honored with wealth.

40020873.author: पदार्थः
40020873.content: एहि come, इदानीम् now, कृतम् done, विद्धि know, सुकृतम् well-done, तत् that, न no, संशयः doubt, आगच्छ come, सौम्य O gentle one, गच्छामः let us go, स्वम् own, एव indeed, भवनम् house, प्रति towards.

40020873.author: Translation
40020873.content: Come now, know that what is done is well done, there is no doubt about it; come, O gentle one, let us go to our own abode.

40020874.author: पदार्थः
40020874.content: ततः then, गत्वा having gone, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सपुत्रः with his sons, सविभीषणः with Vibhishana, स्त्रियः women, अवतारयामास made to descend, सर्वाः all, ताः those, बाष्पगद्गदाः choked with tears.

40020874.author: Translation
40020874.content: Then, having gone, Dashagriva, along with his sons and Vibhishana, brought down all those women who were choked with tears.

40020875.author: पदार्थः
40020875.content: लक्षिण्यः auspicious, रत्नभूताः jewel-like, च and, देवदानवरक्षसाम् of gods, Danavas, and Rakshasas, तस्य his, तासु in them, मतिम् intention, ज्ञात्वा having known, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020875.author: Translation
40020875.content: Knowing his intention towards those auspicious, jewel-like women of gods, Danavas, and Rakshasas, the righteous one (Vibhishana) spoke these words.

40020876.author: पदार्थः
40020876.content: ईदृशैः with such, त्वम् you, समाचारैः actions, यशः fame, अर्थ wealth, कुल family, नाशनैः destroying, धर्षणम् insult, ज्ञातिनाम् of relatives, ज्ञात्वा having known, स्वमतेन by your own will, विचेष्टसे you act.

40020876.author: Translation
40020876.content: You act by your own will with such conduct that destroys fame, wealth, and family, even though you know it is an outrage to your kinsmen.

40020877.author: पदार्थः
40020877.content: ज्ञातीन् relatives, तान् those, धर्षयित्वा having humiliated, इमाः these, त्वया by you, आनीताः brought, वराङ्गनाः beautiful women, त्वाम् you, अतिक्रम्य having transgressed, मधुना by Madhu, राजन् O King, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, हृता abducted.

40020877.author: Translation
40020877.content: O King, while you brought these beautiful women after humiliating their kinsmen, Madhu has abducted Kumbhinasi, disregarding your authority.

40020878.author: पदार्थः
40020878.content: रावणः Ravana, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, वाक्यम् a word, न not, अवगच्छामि I understand, किम् what, तु indeed, इदम् this, कः who, अयम् this, यः who, तु indeed, त्वया by you, आख्यातः mentioned, मधुः Madhu, इति thus, एव indeed, नामतः by name.

40020878.author: Translation
40020878.content: Ravana then spoke, saying, "I do not understand what this is; who is this person named Madhu whom you have mentioned?"

40020879.author: पदार्थः
40020879.content: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु but, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, भ्रातरम् to his brother, वाक्यम् a word, अब्रवीत् said, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, अस्य of this, पापस्य sinful, कर्मणः deed, फलम् fruit, आगतम् arrived.

40020879.author: Translation
40020879.content: But Vibhishana, greatly enraged, spoke to his brother, saying, "Listen, the consequence of this sinful deed has arrived."

40020880.author: पदार्थः
40020880.content: मातामहस्य of the maternal grandfather, यः who, भ्राता brother, ज्येष्ठः elder, भ्राता brother, सुमालिनः of Sumali, माल्यवान् Malyavan, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, वृद्धः old, प्राज्ञः wise, निशाचरः night-wanderer.

40020880.author: Translation
40020880.content: Malyavan, the elder brother of Sumali, who is our maternal grandfather's brother, is a renowned, old, and wise Rakshasa.

40020881.author: पदार्थः
40020881.content: पिता father, ज्येष्ठः elder, जनन्याः of mother, नः our, हि indeed, अस्माकम् our, च and, आर्यकः maternal grandfather, अभवत् was, तस्य his, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, नाम named, दुहितुः of the daughter, दुहिता daughter, अभवत् was.

40020881.author: Translation
40020881.content: He was indeed the elder father of our mother, and thus our maternal grandfather, and his daughter's daughter was named Kumbhinasi.

40020882.author: पदार्थः
40020882.content: मातृष्वसुः of our mother's sister, अथ and, अस्माकम् our, सा she, च and, कन्या daughter, अनलोद्भवा born of Anala, भवति becomes, अस्माकम् our, एव indeed, एषा this, भ्रातृणाम् of brothers, धर्मतः by dharma, स्वसा sister.

40020882.author: Translation
40020882.content: She, the daughter born of Anala, is our mother's sister's daughter, and thus by dharma, she is indeed our sister.

40020883.author: पदार्थः
40020883.content: सा She, हृता was abducted, मधुना by Madhu, राजन् O King, राक्षसेन by the demon, बलीयसा powerful, यज्ञप्रवृत्ते engaged in a sacrifice, पुत्रे when my son (was), तु but, मयि I (was), च and, अन्तर्जलोषिते dwelling inside water.

40020883.author: Translation
40020883.content: O King, she was abducted by the powerful demon Madhu while my son was engaged in a sacrifice and I was dwelling in penance underwater.

40020884.author: पदार्थः
40020884.content: कुम्भकर्णे when Kumbhakarna (was), महाराज O great king, निद्राम् sleep, अनुभवति experiencing, अथ then, निहत्य having killed, राक्षसश्रेष्ठान् the best of demons, अमात्यान् ministers, इह here, सम्मतान् respected.

40020884.author: Translation
40020884.content: O great king, at that time, while Kumbhakarna was experiencing his long sleep, Madhu killed the best and most respected demon ministers here.

40020885.author: पदार्थः
40020885.content: धर्षयित्वा having violated, हृता was abducted, सा she, तु but, सुप्ता sleeping, अपि even, अन्तःपुरे in the inner chambers, तव your, श्रुत्वा having heard, अपि even, तत् that, महाराज O great king, क्षान्तम् forgiven, एव indeed, हतः killed, न not, सः he.

40020885.author: Translation
40020885.content: She was abducted after being violated, even while sleeping in your inner chambers, yet, O great king, even after hearing of that, he was indeed forgiven and not killed.

40020886.author: पदार्थः
40020886.content: यस्मात् because, अवश्यम् certainly, दातव्या to be given, कन्या a daughter, भर्त्रे to the husband, हि indeed, भ्रातृभिः by brothers, तत् that, एतत् this, कर्मणः of the action, हि indeed, अस्य his, फलम् fruit, पापस्य of the sinful, दुर्मते O evil-minded one.

40020886.author: Translation
40020886.content: Because a daughter must indeed be given to her husband by her brothers, this, O evil-minded one, is truly the consequence of his sinful act.

40020887.author: पदार्थः
40020887.content: अस्मिन् in this, एव indeed, अभिसम्प्राप्तम् arrived, लोके in the world, विदितम् known, अस्तु let it be, ते to you, विभीषणवचः Vibhishana's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, राक्षसेन्द्रः king of demons, सः that, रावणः Ravana, दौरात्म्येन by wickedness, आत्मना by himself, उद्धूतः agitated, तप्ताम्भः hot water, इव like, सागरः ocean.

40020887.author: Translation
40020887.content: Let it be known to you that upon hearing Vibhishana's words, that king of demons Ravana was agitated by his own wickedness, like an ocean stirred by hot water.

40020888.author: पदार्थः
40020888.content: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Ravana, क्रुद्धः enraged, संरक्तलोचनः with reddened eyes, कल्प्यताम् let it be prepared, मे my, रथः chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, शूराः brave warriors, सज्जीभवन्तु let them be ready, नः our.

40020888.author: Translation
40020888.content: Then, Ravana, enraged and with reddened eyes, spoke, saying, "Let my chariot be prepared quickly, and let our brave warriors be ready."

40020889.author: पदार्थः
40020889.content: भ्राता brother, मे my, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, च and, ये who, च and, मुख्याः chief, निशाचराः demons, वाहनानि mounts, अधिरोहन्तु let them mount, नानाप्रहरणायुधाः armed with various weapons.

40020889.author: Translation
40020889.content: My brother Kumbhakarna and the other chief demons, armed with various weapons, should mount their vehicles.

40020890.author: पदार्थः
40020890.content: अद्य today, तम् him, समरे in battle, हत्वा having killed, मधुम् Madhu, रावणनिर्भयम् fearless of Ravana, सुरलोकम् to the world of gods, गमिष्यामि I shall go, युद्धकाङ्क्षी desirous of battle, सुहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends.

40020890.author: Translation
40020890.content: Today, having killed Madhu in battle, who is fearless of Ravana, I shall go to the world of gods, desirous of battle and surrounded by my friends.

40020891.author: पदार्थः
40020891.content: अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणि thousands of Akshauhinis, चत्वारि four, अग्र्याणि foremost, रक्षसाम् of demons, नानाप्रहरणानि with various weapons, आशु quickly, निर्ययुः set out, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् desirous of battle.

40020891.author: Translation
40020891.content: Four thousand foremost Akshauhinis of demons, armed with various weapons and eager for battle, quickly set out.

40020892.author: पदार्थः
40020892.content: इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, तु and, अग्रतः in front, सैन्यात् from the army, सैनिकान् soldiers, परिगृह्य having gathered, च and, जगाम went, रावणः Ravana, मध्ये in the middle, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, च and, पृष्ठतः at the back.

40020892.author: Translation
40020892.content: Indrajit led the army from the front, Ravana marched in the middle, and Kumbhakarna followed at the rear.

40020893.author: पदार्थः
40020893.content: विभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, लङ्कायां in Lanka, धर्मम् righteousness, आचरत् practiced, शेषाः the remaining ones, सर्वे all, महाभागाः illustrious ones, ययुः went, मधुपुरं to Madhupura, प्रति towards.

40020893.author: Translation
40020893.content: The righteous Vibhishana remained in Lanka practicing dharma, while all the other illustrious remaining ones went towards Madhupura.

40020894.author: पदार्थः
40020894.content: खरैः with donkeys, उष्ट्रैः with camels, हयैः with horses, दीप्तैः splendid, शिंशुमारैः with porpoises, महोरगैः with great serpents, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, प्रययुः went forth, सर्वे all, कृत्वा having made, आकाशं the sky, निरन्तरम् completely filled.

40020894.author: Translation
40020894.content: All the Rakshasas set forth, mounted on donkeys, camels, splendid horses, porpoises, and great serpents, completely filling the sky.

40020895.author: पदार्थः
40020895.content: दैत्याः Daityas, च and, शतशः by hundreds, तत्र there, कृतवैराः who had enmity, च and, दैवतैः with the gods, रावणं Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, गच्छन्तम् going, अन्वगच्छन् followed, हि indeed, पृष्ठतः from behind.

40020895.author: Translation
40020895.content: Hundreds of Daityas, who had long-standing enmity with the gods, saw Ravana going and indeed followed him from behind.

40020896.author: पदार्थः
40020896.content: सः He, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, मधुपुरं to Madhupura, प्रविश्य having entered, च and, दशाननः Ravana, न not, ददर्श saw, मधुं Madhu, तत्र there, भगिनीं his sister, तत्र there, दृष्टवान् saw.

40020896.author: Translation
40020896.content: Having gone to Madhupura and entered it, Ravana did not find Madhu there, but instead saw his sister.

40020897.author: पदार्थः
40020897.content: सा she, च and, प्रह्वाञ्जलिर्भूत्वा having become humble with folded hands, शिरसा with her head, चरणौ (his) feet, गता reached.

40020897.author: Translation
40020897.content: And she, becoming humble with folded hands, touched his feet with her head.

40020898.author: पदार्थः
40020898.content: तस्य of that, राक्षसराजस्य king of Rakshasas, त्रस्ता frightened, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, तदा then, ताम् her, समुत्थापयामास made to rise, न not, भेतव्यम् to be feared, इति thus, ब्रुवन् saying.

40020898.author: Translation
40020898.content: Then, Kumbhinasi, frightened by that king of Rakshasas, made her rise, saying, "You should not be afraid."

40020899.author: पदार्थः
40020899.content: रावणो Ravana, राक्षसश्रेष्ठः O best of Rakshasas, किम् what, च and, अपि also, करवाणि shall I do, ते for you? साब्रवीत् she said, यदि if, मे to me, राजन् O king, प्रसन्नस्त्वम् you are pleased, महाभुज O mighty-armed one, भर्तारम् husband, न not, मम my, इह here, अद्य today, हन्तुम् to kill, अर्हसि you ought, मानद O giver of honor.

40020899.author: Translation
40020899.content: Ravana, O best of Rakshasas, asked, "What else shall I do for you?" She replied, "If you are pleased with me, O king, O mighty-armed one, O giver of honor, then you should not kill my husband here today."

40020900.author: पदार्थः
40020900.content: न not, हि indeed, ईदृशम् such, भयम् fear, किञ्चित् any, कुलस्त्रीणाम् for noble women, इह here, उच्यते is said. भयानाम् of fears, अपि even, सर्वेषाम् all, वैधव्यम् widowhood, व्यसनम् calamity, महत् great.

40020900.author: Translation
40020900.content: Indeed, no such fear is spoken of for noble women in this world, for among all fears, widowhood is the greatest calamity.

40020901.author: पदार्थः
40020901.content: सत्यवाग्भव be truthful in speech, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, माम् me, अवेक्षस्व consider, याचतीम् who is begging. त्वयापि by you also, उक्तम् was said, महाराज O great king, न not, भेतव्यम् to be feared, इति thus, स्वयम् yourself.

40020901.author: Translation
40020901.content: O king of kings, be truthful in your word and consider me, who is begging, for you yourself, O great king, said, "You should not be afraid."

40020902.author: पदार्थः
40020902.content: रावणः Ravana, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् said, धृष्टः impudent, स्वसारं to his sister, तत्र there, संस्थिताम् standing, क्व where, च and, असौ that, तव your, भर्ता husband, वै indeed, मम to me, शीघ्रं quickly, निवेद्यताम् let him be reported.

40020902.author: Translation
40020902.content: Impudent Ravana said to his sister, who was standing there, "Where is your husband? Show him to me quickly."

40020903.author: पदार्थः
40020903.content: सह with, तेन him, गमिष्यामि I shall go, सुरलोकं to the world of gods, जयावहे for victory, तव your, कारुण्यसौहार्दात् due to compassion and friendship, निवृत्तः stopped, अस्मि I am, मधोः of Madhu, वधात् from killing.

40020903.author: Translation
40020903.content: I will go with him to conquer the world of the gods, and because of your compassion and friendship, I have refrained from killing Madhu.

40020904.author: पदार्थः
40020904.content: इति thus, उक्ता addressed, सा she, समुत्थाप्य having awakened, प्रसुप्तं sleeping, तं that, निशाचरम् night-wanderer, अब्रवीत् spoke, सम्प्रहृष्टा as if greatly delighted, राक्षसी the female demon, सा she, पतिं to her husband, वचः words.

40020904.author: Translation
40020904.content: Thus addressed, she, the female demon, awakened her sleeping husband, the night-wanderer, and spoke words to him as if greatly delighted.

40020905.author: पदार्थः
40020905.content: एषः this, प्राप्तः arrived, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, मम my, भ्राता brother, महाबलः very powerful, सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी desirous of conquering the world of gods, साहाय्ये for help, त्वां you, वृणोति chooses, च and.

40020905.author: Translation
40020905.content: My very powerful brother Dashagriva has arrived, desirous of conquering the world of the gods, and he requests your assistance.

40020906.author: पदार्थः
40020906.content: तत् therefore, अस्य his, त्वं you, सहायार्थं for the purpose of help, सबन्धुः with your relatives, गच्छ go, राक्षस O Rakshasa, स्निग्धस्य of an affectionate one, भजमानस्य who seeks (help), युक्तम् it is proper, अर्थाय for the purpose, कल्पितुम् to provide.

40020906.author: Translation
40020906.content: Therefore, O Rakshasa, you should go with your relatives to help him, for it is proper to provide assistance to an affectionate one who seeks it.

40020907.author: पदार्थः
40020907.content: तस्याः her, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, तथा so be it, इति thus, आह said, मधुः Madhu, वचः words.

40020907.author: Translation
40020907.content: Having heard her words, Madhu replied, "So be it."

40020908.author: पदार्थः
40020908.content: ददर्श he saw, राक्षसश्रेष्ठं the best of Rakshasas, यथान्यायम् according to custom, उपेत्य having approached, सः he, पूजयमास worshipped, धर्मेण righteously, रावणं Ravana, राक्षसाधिपम् the lord of Rakshasas.

40020908.author: Translation
40020908.content: He approached Ravana, the best and lord of Rakshasas, and worshipped him according to custom and righteousness.

40020909.author: पदार्थः
40020909.content: प्राप्य having received, पूजां worship, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), मधुवेश्मानि in Madhu's abode, वीर्यवान् the powerful one, तत्र there, च and, एकाम् one, निशाम् night, उष्य having stayed, गमनाय for departure, उपचक्रमे began.

40020909.author: Translation
40020909.content: The powerful Ravana, having received worship in Madhu's abode and stayed there for one night, then prepared for his departure.

40020910.author: पदार्थः
40020910.content: ततः then, कैलासम् Kailasa, आसाद्य having reached, शैलं mountain, वैश्रवणालयम् the abode of Vaishravana (Kubera), राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, महेन्द्राभः resembling Mahendra (Indra), सेनाम् army, उपनिवेशयत् encamped.

40020910.author: Translation
40020910.content: Then, the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, who resembled Mahendra, reached Mount Kailasa, the abode of Kubera, and encamped his army there.
